name: デモザイクアーティファクト分析
description: 分析します color filter array demosaicing アーティファクト to verify camera origin and detect synthetic images.
mechanism: This armored tank crushes the visible RGB surface to violently reverse-engineer the image back to its 'primordial' Bayer matrix probability logic (RGGB/BGGR). It relentlessly sweeps the color grid, mathematically interrogating whether a pixel’s Blue channel was legitimately interpolated from its neighboring Green channels using hardware algorithms. If a deepfake face or Midjourney tree is spliced into the frame, the algorithm triggers a massive forensic meltdown upon detecting a complete absence—or violent collision—of CFA interpolation signatures, mathematically proving the imposter possesses no organic hardware origin.
parameters: CFA パターン: RGGB, Interpolation: bilinear/AHD/VNG, Correlation window: 5×5, Analysis: cross-channel
source: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Demosaicing, ACM IHMMSec
